text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Yuki-chan. For a change, I've 
decided to write you a letter today 
instead of calling or messaging on LANE."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"My badge test is coming up soon! 
...Though I never thought it'd fall on the 
exact same day as Yuki-chan's big race."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"If I want to aim for the world 
championships... If I want to make my 
dream come true, this is my last chance 
given my age. Honestly, I'm really 
terrified."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"What if I mess up the jump? What if, 
after working this hard, it all ends up 
being for nothing... What do I do?"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"...So, yeah, I take it back after all. 
I'm glad it overlapped with Yuki-chan's 
important race."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"Because with Yuki-chan working so hard, I 
can't afford to lose to myself. —Let's 
both do our best!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Work hard, and get closer to your dream"—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'm... heading out now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm heading off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right before the Japan Cup, an 
extraordinary heat filled the venue.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, I can't wait! To think the Snow 
Angel and the model Umamusume are actually 
gonna face off...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, that's not it! Call them Yukino 
Bijin-chan and Gold City-san!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Those two are sure to put on a thrilling 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans A & B
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chan, do your beeeeeeest!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Today... let's put on our best run ever.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Let's run a race that we can truly believe 
is our best. A race that makes us love 
ourselves after crossing the finish 
line... Let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Of course!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Let's go, City-san. To our race!
